name: Normal lakeshore swim to original Vilverin shore

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local points={{{{48200,87900,0}},{{50700,87400,410}}}}
local index=1
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during Vilverin travel')
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 if index>#points then print('VilverinTravel arrived');return end
 local p=points[index];local target=util.vector3(p[1],p[2],p[3]);local v=target-self.position
 if math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)<90 then print('VilverinTravel reached='..index);index=index+1;return end
 local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 local pitch=0
 if math.abs(angle)<0.035 then print('VilverinTravel ready='..index) end
 print(string.format('VilverinTravel aim x=%d y=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f health=%.2f magicka=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*256+.5))),self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,v:length(),Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current,Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current))
end}}}}
